susceptibility_note: Peaks refer to the reweighted composition variance, without a Q cut. Its two standard deviations approach the binodal width only in the asymptotic two-phase regime.
spatial_note: A terminal snapshot per window. Null permutations preserve all four sublattice occupancies. Significant power is compatible with spatial chemical correlations, including domains.
size_crossing_note: Compare mean concentration at the same field for successive sizes. The strongest positive-slope crossing is a field estimate. Optional endpoint estimates use a two-phase limiting mixture and linear 1/N corrections to variance and third central moment.
